theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ah : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Ψ : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (U : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (R c d : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ α → Tendsto R atTop atTop → Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 0) → Continuous V → (∀ r : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn U V atTop (closedBall (0 : Rn n) r)) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (fun p : Rn n × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) => ah k p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k) ×ˢ univ)) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (Ψ k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (U k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |ah k z P Q - A P Q| ≤ c k * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ α) * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Ψ k z Q| ≤ d k * ‖z‖ ^ α * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ah k z (U k z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = ∫ z in ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), Ψ k z (fderiv ℝ ζ z)) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ z, A (V z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = 0
